title: Charging Kiosk Outage Hours as Booked where the Outage is Material
content:
Where the kiosk outage hours read on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement are material, they are charged as booked rather than pared back, and any kiosk outage request declined over the half year reduces them hour for hour.

## Conditions

**The hours are charged as booked** where the hours so read are at or above 8, and no kiosk outage request on the agreement was declined over the six months to the day the credit is worked out.

**The hours are charged as booked less one hour for each declined request, and never below nothing**, where the hours so read are at or above 8, and at least one kiosk outage request on the agreement was declined over those six months.

**Where the hours so read are below 8**, no such change to the chargeable hours is made.

## The boundary

The material outage hours figure is 8: hours read of exactly 8 are at or above it, and hours read of 7 are below it. The deduction under the second condition is one hour for each declined request, and the chargeable hours are never taken below nothing.

*Hypothetical.* Eleven hours read with no declined request over the half year are charged as 11. Eleven hours read with three declined requests over that half year are charged as 8. Eleven hours read with fourteen declined requests are charged as nothing, the deduction never taking the figure below nothing. Seven hours read fall below the material outage hours and reach neither condition.
